ideas.pain_point: Players are consistently disappointed by new game releases that are overpriced, lack content, or are riddled with bugs and aggressive monetization, leading to a feeling of poor value for money.
ideas.solution_description: Establish an industry-wide 'Player Value Assurance' standard or certification, focusing on transparent pricing, guaranteed content quality at launch, and fair monetization practices, potentially including a more robust refund policy for games failing to meet advertised standards.
ideas.target_user: General video game consumers, especially those purchasing new AAA titles.
